body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> LG Electronics presented its mobile phone ‘LG-LH2000’ during KES 2007, which supports 'CDMA2000 1x EV-DO Rev.A' including high-speed multimedia service from LG Telecom. The LG-LH2000 enables users to enjoy T-DMB and video calling with a swing style 2.2-inch LCD display. Other features included 2M camera, micro SD external memory slot and Bluetooth connection at price of mid-500,000(KRW).
